subject: Invoice sending preference & VAT evidence for Q3 charges
messages:
From: Nadine Park <nadine.park@vividapps.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: VividApps Accounts <accounts@vividapps.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Billing: how will you send Q3 invoice?

Hi Connor,

We’ve got a PO ready on our side (attached) for the upcoming Q3 usage. Quick question on delivery: our AP team prefers invoices via our portal (they can ingest XML), but they also asked if you can email a PDF copy to accounts@vividapps.com for reconciliation.

Also: we’re EU-registered and have a VAT certificate — would Redwood need that on file before you zero-rate the cross-border charge?

What do you recommend as the fastest path to get the invoice out and the PO matched?

Thanks,
Nadine Park
Head of Finance
VividApps

Attachment: VividApps_PO_334.pdf (pdf, 98KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Nadine Park <nadine.park@vividapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, VividApps Accounts <accounts@vividapps.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Billing: how will you send Q3 invoice?

Hi Nadine — thanks for the PO and the heads-up. Short answer: we can do both.

Plan I’d recommend (fastest, least manual):
- We’ll publish the official invoice to your portal (XML) so your AP system can ingest immediately.
- We’ll also send a PDF copy to accounts@vividapps.com for internal reconciliation/finance review.

On VAT: yes — please attach your VAT registration certificate (EU VIES or equivalent). Once we have that on file we can mark the invoice with the appropriate VAT handling and include the VAT ID on the invoice.

Two quick asks so we don’t delay billing:
1) Confirm the AP portal company ID (if you have one) or the preferred XML schema (we support the standard XML preview; I attached a sample to show mapping).
2) Confirm whether accounts@vividapps.com should be the primary billing contact (we’ll CC any others you list).

I’ve looped in Ben from billing to confirm portal transmission details and to generate the preview.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_invoice_preview.xml (xml, stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Nadine Park <nadine.park@vividapps.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: VividApps Accounts <accounts@vividapps.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 11:01:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Billing: how will you send Q3 invoice?

Nadine / Connor — quick operational note from billing ops.

We support both delivery channels simultaneously: XML to portal and PDF by email. When you submit the VAT certificate we’ll add it to the customer record and include the VAT ID on the invoice. A couple of specifics that help us match the PO quickly:
- Please include the PO number in the invoice reference field (PO: 334).
- If your portal needs a specific payer company ID, paste that here (AccountNum / VendorID).
- If you want a separate remit-to address (different from the legal entity on file), let us know now — otherwise we’ll use the legal entity details from your HubSpot record.

We can also enable an automated notification so your AP gets a webhook when the XML lands; we use SFTP or HTTPS push depending on partner setup. If you want to test with the XML preview I attached, reply here and I’ll trigger a sandbox push.

We do need the VAT certificate to finalize tax handling — you can drop that in reply or upload to the Drive link Connor shared.

Thanks — I’ll queue the invoice generation once we have the confirmation on portal ID and VAT doc.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none in this message)

From: Nadine Park <nadine.park@vividapps.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: VividApps Accounts <accounts@vividapps.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Billing: how will you send Q3 invoice?

Thanks — that sounds good.

We’ll:
- Register the portal company ID this afternoon (AccountNum: VA-7789)
- Upload the VIES certificate to the Drive link you sent and also attach it here.
- Keep accounts@vividapps.com as primary billing contact (they’ll receive the PDF).

We attached the VAT certificate for your records. Please generate the invoice with PO: 334, include our VAT ID (BE0123456789), and push XML to the portal. A PDF copy to accounts@vividapps.com is perfect.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — once you confirm the portal push we’ll close the PO internally.

Best,
Nadine
Nadine Park
Head of Finance, VividApps
